title: helm: private chart values schema + init-jobs/hooks migration and templating cleanup
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: stabilize the Redwood Private Helm chart values schema and make init jobs/hooks explicit and idempotent to improve upgrades and rollbacks for on-prem/VPC installations. This change migrates values.schema.json to v3, tightens encryption and KMS-related validation, extracts init-job templates into a single reusable chart template, and converts init hooks to proper Helm hook annotations with backoff/timeout controls. The PR also adds stricter nodeSelector/toleration handling, documents expected upgrade/rollback behavior, and includes a rolling compatibility shim for clusters still using older annotations. Checklist: [x] update values.schema.json to v3 with clear required fields for kms/encryption and storage [x] refactor templates/init-jobs.yaml into templates/_init-jobs.tpl and call from daemonset/statefulset hooks [x] replace legacy pre-install hooks with pre-install/pre-upgrade that are idempotent and support --atomic upgrades [x] add validation to CI for schema and basic templating render [x] add upgrade/rollback notes to CHART.md This is intended to reduce manual intervention during upgrade rollouts and prevent failures seen in SUP-1142 where incomplete init-hooks caused fused state on nodes.

notes_for_release: Helm chart: values.schema.json v3. Init-job templates and hooks refactored for idempotency and improved upgrade/rollback behavior. Add explicit defaults for nodeSelector/tolerations and KMS/encryption validation. Users should read charts/private/CHART.md before upgrading.
upgrade_rollback_guidance: When upgrading from 2.x charts, first render templates with --debug --dry-run to detect deprecated fields. If legacy initHook fields are present, the chart will emit a warning and map them to the new hook spec. For canary upgrades use Helm --atomic in combination with the new hook backoff settings. To rollback, use `helm rollback` and ensure any init-jobs are observed to have completed or have backoff exhausted; if nodes retain partial state, follow CHART.md troubleshooting steps.
testing_notes: Added chart unit tests that render templates with representative values including encryption enabled, kms key set, nodeSelector variations, and legacy shim. CI now runs schema validation and template render on every PR.
